naya.summary: Stabilize the fixed result pipeline, extract a pure deterministic scoring engine, lock an assessment contract, then generalize to topic-driven generation. Do not rebuild the house.
lessons: Gaps included selector/version mismatch, competing results navigation, hard-coded scoring, missing dynamic-generation schema/validator, and insufficient regression coverage.
Generation should be provider-abstracted, cached, rate-limited, schema-validated, and separated from deterministic scoring.

human.summary: Repair the foundation first, make scoring its own reliable engine second, then make assessments work for any subject.
lessons: Fix the foundation before adding the ocean.
One result object and one scoring authority should feed every results section.
